reviews.title: Gorgeous MB.
reviews.comment: Solid MB that has a good boot system, booting windows in seconds from power on. Not a huge fan of the bios platform, but it's reliable. Was entirely compatible with all my other parts. I just wish it had more USB headers, but that's an easy problem to solve with a hub hidden in the chassis of your case.
reviews.author: Hyicen

reviews.title: buena placa madre y su BIOS es muy practica e intuitiva para los Intel Core ULTRA 200
reviews.comment: Es buena placa madre gama media para los procesadores core ultra 200, su bios es muy básica pero muy completa e intuitiva, la tuve con un Intel Core Ultra 7 265K y anduvo excelente, la dejaré para armar un pc de la casa porque adquerí una placa madre gama superior para hacer overclock al Ultra 7, una Z890 MSI me compré ahora.
reviews.author: Pedro Gamboa

reviews.title: Solid Motherboard
reviews.comment:
Just installed this with a Core Ultra 7 265k. This board is heavy and feels well constructed.
The only issue I had was the LED bar at the bottom stays powered 24/7, it can be turned off with Asrock's RGB software though. The VRM heatsinks also blocked my Nzxt X53 cooler from being installed in its usual orientation.
Overall a solid product from ASRock. No issues with stability or performance so far. Hopefully it lasts for years to come like the Msi board it relaced.
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.title: They removed the Thunderbolt connection from the board.
reviews.comment: Works well but had to mention that if you are looking something with thunderbolt connection on the board this is not your motherboard. The pictures show a thunderbolt 5 connection on the bottom of the board, but they cut the pins from the motherboard.
reviews.author: Alejandra Camargo

reviews.title: Surprise: OPEN BOX
reviews.comment: It turned out to be an open box item, and I can't test it till the rest of my build arrives. But open box and advertised as new is NOT ethical
